action_items: (LOW, carry-over) server.py is now ~8883 lines. Iter22 added _fire_agenda_n8n + AgendaWebhookCreate + webhook_agenda_n8n + admin_usage_summary (~250 lines). Consider splitting into routers: agenda.py (appointments + n8n webhook), admin_usage.py, otp.py.

(LOW) Outbound n8n webhook is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task — there is no retry, no DLQ. If the n8n endpoint is unreachable, the event is dropped silently with only logger.warning. Acceptable for MVP but flag for future hardening (Outbox table + cron retry).

(LOW) /admin/usage/summary daily_series queries db.whatsapp_messages and db.ai_summaries in two full collection scans within the date window — fine at current volume but add an index on created_at for both collections before scaling beyond ~500K rows.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_login (server.py L588-608): clean per-domain OTP routing — internal_domains parsed from settings (lowercased, stripped, '@' prefix tolerated), default 'sawalismartsystems.com' baked-in so admin always works even when settings doc is empty. is_internal_user → message='Plateforme Interne…' + dev_otp=code (always shown). External user → SMTP attempt; on failure → French fallback message + dev_otp returned. ✓
auth_resend_otp (L630-652): SAME internal_domains rule applied — no drift. Returns {sent:false, dev_otp:new_code} for internal users. ✓

_fire_agenda_n8n (L983-1024): properly async + best-effort with try/except + 10s timeout. Auth_type switch (none/bearer/basic) is exhaustive. Strips MongoDB '_id' from appointment payload before serialization. Includes user.client_id || user.id for the n8n side. ✓

webhook_agenda_n8n (L1038-1130): unauthenticated by design — secret is passed as path token compared with constant-time-ish equality (== is fine for opaque tokens). Disabled → 503; wrong secret → 403; action enum validated; create requires scheduled_at+subject+client_email; update requires appointment_id. Reuses _check_slot_available so AI agent cannot double-book. source='n8n' tag distinguishes from manual creates (no gcal_event_id). ✓

me_appointments (L965-974): admin/superviseur unrestricted; everyone else scoped via user.client_id || user.id. This unifies tracked-user view with parent-client view (verified by test_tracked_user_shares_parent_scope). ✓

me_create_appointment (L1192-1249): client_scope = user.client_id || user.id stored on doc. Background tasks: _emit_event('appointment.created') for SMS/WA automations + _fire_agenda_n8n('created') for n8n outbound. PUT/DELETE handlers (L1149-1189) similarly fire 'updated'/'deleted'. ✓

admin_usage_summary (L1488-1582): one async iteration per collection (clients, wa_pipeline, ai_pipeline, daily wa, daily ai). Sort key = wa_cost + ai_summaries DESC matches the spec. Days clamp max(1, min(days, 365)) is correct. daily_series pre-fills all N days with zeros so the chart never has gaps. _normalize_features ensures every row has the 4 boolean flags. ✓

admin_get_settings + admin_update_settings (L4906-4945): SECRET_FIELDS list extended with the 3 new agenda secrets (agenda_n8n_outbound_token, agenda_n8n_outbound_basic_pass, agenda_n8n_inbound_secret); '********' placeholder detection prevents accidental overwrite. Round-trip verified. ✓
AdminUsage.jsx — 11 testids confirmed live. KpiCard component reuse keeps the layout DRY. CSV export (usage-export) wired to client-side blob download. ✓

AdminSettings.jsx — internal-domains Input wired to upd('internal_domains'). Agenda Section uses 2 grouped inner cards (out/in) with conditional render of token vs basic-user/pass driven by auth-type select — testable, predictable. ✓
Login.jsx — loginMsg state distinguishes internal vs external; class branch sawali-blue (interne) vs amber (other) verified visually + by class assertion. ✓

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter22 suite = /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter22.py (5 classes / 14 tests, ~5s). Pytest invocation: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter22.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter22.xml`. Notes: (1) test seeds users with bcrypt directly (passlib's bcrypt-version probing fails in this env — use raw `bcrypt.hashpw`). (2) Backend uses `account_status: 'active'` not `is_active: True` — must match when seeding. (3) Inbound webhook lowercases client_email — seed users with lowercased email. (4) Appointment creation enforces business hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 UTC) — use _next_business_slot helper. (5) The /webhooks/agenda/{secret} is unauthenticated by design (path secret IS the auth). (6) After all tests, settings_snapshot fixture restores internal_domains + agenda_n8n_* fields to their pre-test state. Frontend OTP page uses 6 separate digit inputs that are not labeled with inputmode/maxlength — `form input` selector with .nth() works. The test typed each digit individually.
rca of the issue: Three test-time issues encountered during initial run, all fixed: (1) `from passlib.context import CryptContext` failed in this env with `AttributeError: module 'bcrypt' has no attribute '__about__'` (passlib≤1.7.x can't probe bcrypt≥4.x version cleanly). Replaced with raw `bcrypt.hashpw`. (2) Seeded users had `is_active: True` but backend checks `account_status == 'active'` → got 403 'Compte désactivé'. Switched seed key. (3) Test scheduled appointments at `now + N days` UTC which sometimes landed on a weekend or outside 09:00-18:00 → got 409 'Hors des heures ouvrables'. Added `_next_business_slot` helper that picks next Mon-Fri at a fixed business hour.
